__comment: SPHERE TRANSFORM INVARIANCE, part 1 of 2. A diffuse sphere centred exactly on the origin, lit by a point light. Ray traced with NumSamples 1 so the result is deterministic. Must match sphere_rot, which applies a rigid rotation about that same origin: a sphere is invariant under rotation about its own centre, so the two images must be identical. A mismatch means the ray direction is being transformed by the wrong matrix (inverse-transpose is the NORMAL transform, not the direction transform).
